## What
- The needs-you queue no longer raises the withdrawn-draft row for an OPEN card batch that is still collecting cards (inside its window, no sealFailure). It still raises when the batch is past its deadline or card count, or has a sealFailure. Only the `draft-withdrawn` row is suppressed.
- After `VERIFY_UNRUN_CAP` unrun verifies the seal now stores `verifyRetryAfter` (+15 min, via a settings cascade) and keeps the state instead of a permanent sealFailure. `sealDueBatches` re-arms (resets `verifyUnrun`) after the pause when the heavy queue has a free slot. A verify that RAN and FAILED still holds.

## Proof
Tests: 116/116 (hold-state incl. #5790 shape and past-deadline batch; seal-io defer/re-arm/race). Read-only Codex audit: 3 P2 fixed, re-audit NO FINDINGS. verify green.
